title: GetTimeZoneResponse
description: Response schema for the TimezoneDB get-time-zone endpoint. Returns timezone information for a location looked up by zone name, coordinates, city, or IP address.

message.description: Error message; empty string if successful.

countryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the timezone.

regionName.description: Region or state name. Available on premium plans.

cityName.description: City or place name. Available on premium plans.

abbreviation.description: Timezone abbreviation for the current period.

gmtOffset.description: UTC offset in seconds. Positive = east of UTC, negative = west.

dst.description: Daylight Saving Time flag returned as string. '0' = No DST, '1' = DST active.

zoneStart.description: Unix timestamp when the current timezone period started.

zoneEnd.description: Unix timestamp when the current timezone period ends. -1 if no end date.

nextAbbreviation.description: Timezone abbreviation for the next period after zoneEnd.

timestamp.description: Current local time as a Unix timestamp.

formatted.description: Human-readable local time in Y-m-d H:i:s format.

totalPage.description: Total number of pages available for paginated results (city lookup).

currentPage.description: Current page number in paginated results.
